tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha khang mkhan po chos bkra shis gsar bkod skabs sgo rum snyan dar zhal byang // na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ye/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po gdul bya'i don du gdug pa can gyi sha khrag rus pa las grub pa'i sku yi snang brnyan srin po'i gzugs su shar ba bse mgon yid bzhin nor bu'i spyan sngar lha rdzas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshor sprul te 'bul ba lags na dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung brgyud sde dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / bye brag tu chos rje khu dbon gyi slob rgyun bshad grwa thub bstan lha khang chen mo dang / rje btsun gong ma'i man ngag 'dzin pa'i sngags grwa bod can gling na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbu bla'i 'os ming byang zan ril gyi nang bzhugs 'di rnams kyi nang nas rje btsun gong ma'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa la phan nges shing chos grwa chen po 'di nyid la 'dzin skyong spel gsum thub nges shig bzang thon stsol ba dang / de yi lus srog longs spyod lung rtogs kyi yon tan la 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa ci mchis myur du zhi nas/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bye brag tu yang phar tshad 'dul mngon dbu ma sdom rig gi bshad grwa slob rgyun bzang po yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas nas de dag gi yan lag rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la byang chub pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bus rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab par bskrun te/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i ring lugs rnam par dag pa sa skya'i rje btsun gyi bzhed gzhung dri ma med pa 'di nyid sa phyogs ris gang na su bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu thams cad la khyab nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde yid bzhin du bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba ltar 'bad med du 'byung ba dang /

zab mo smin grol gyi lam la brten nas sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa sogs mdor na rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi thugs bzhed la bzhugs shing bdag gis smon pa'i gnas thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol// //sarba madga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ lha khang mkhan po gsar bkod skabs sgo rum snyan dar zhal byang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
